A total of 16 teams contested the league with [[MO Constantine]] as the defending champions. The Championnat started on October 24, 1991 and ended on October 12, 1992. ==Team summaries== === Promotion and relegation === '''Teams promoted from 1991–92 Algerian Division 2'''{{Cite web
